[Context: own implementation. Vanuatu has been fortunate to receive some very large external financing]
for single diseases, including a budget of over VT 222 million for malaria control in 2012 alone.

But despite - or perhaps because of - such large payments, some opportunities may have been

missed to leverage broader and much-needed health system strengthening. Using large disease-

specific funds to have, in effect, a separate and parallel human resources system will not help

strengthen the health system more broadly.
